update ${database.prefix.activity}hou_addon_activity_piecing_together_mark

mapper.select: select pd.price_ori,pd.price,pd.common_id,pd.goods_id,gc.common_image,gc.common_name from ${database.prefix.activity}hou_addon_activity_piecing_together_mark pm LEFT JOIN ${database.prefix.activity}hou_addon_activity_piecing_together_detail pd on pm.detail_id = pd.detail_id Left JOIN ${database.prefix.goods}hou_goods_common gc on pd.common_id = gc.common_id where mark_id = #{markId}

SELECT mark_id FROM ${database.prefix.activity}hou_addon_activity_piecing_together_mark WHERE detail_id in ( SELECT detail_id FROM ${database.prefix.activity}hou_addon_activity_piecing_together_detail WHERE pintuan_id = #{pintuanId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ) AND STATUS = 0

SELECT count( 1 ) FROM ${database.prefix.activity}hou_addon_activity_piecing_together_temp tt LEFT JOIN ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_base ob ON tt.order_id = ob.order_id WHERE tt.mark_id = #{markId} and ob.order_status != 3 and ob.order_id != #{orderId}
select tt.order_id from ${database.prefix.activity}hou_addon_activity_piecing_together_temp tt where tt.mark_id = #{markId}
mapper.update: update ${database.prefix.activity}hou_addon_activity_piecing_together_mark set status = 1 where mark_id = #{markId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and status = 0
mapper.select: select pp.person_num from ${database.prefix.activity}hou_addon_activity_piecing_together_mark pm left join ${database.prefix.activity}hou_addon_activity_piecing_together_detail pd on pm.detail_id = pd.detail_id left join ${database.prefix.activity}hou_addon_activity_piecing_together pp on pd.pintuan_id = pp.pintuan_id where pm.mark_id = #{markId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
